details: Version 0.4.7 of the @onereach/si-dropdown-simple Vue component adds a preinstall hook (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases and executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload (math_init.js) with it. The payload is obfuscated with the javascript-obfuscator tool (a large _0x dictionary array plus a custom base64 decoder) and contains eval, Function, and child_process usage, hiding its actual behavior. The package's declared component code is a normal Vue dropdown with no legitimate need to download a runtime or run an obfuscated script at install time.
